incidents.name: Unibot router approval drain
incidents.notes: The Unibot router deployed on 2023-10-28 exposed an unauthenticated entry point that performed a caller-specified transferFrom, so the attacker could pull arbitrary ERC20 balances out of every wallet that had approved the router.

sources.ref: onchain review: router 0x126c9fbab3a2fca24edfd17322e71a5e36e91865 created 2023-10-28 by 0x40800a492a04ae99c7fa6a0c2b52e3beb6675a0d (Unibot deployer), unrelated to attack sender 0x413e4fb75c300b92fec12d7c44e4c0b4faab4d04; contract unverified on Etherscan; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, so the exploited code was 2.4 days old; the attacker drained 17+ user wallets across several txs, ~$640k total, later reimbursed by the team
